Q: When does requesting intermediate reasoning make an application less reliable?
spoken: Extra reasoning text can increase latency, expose sensitive input or create an unsupported appearance of certainty. Evaluate whether a structured plan, decomposition or tool call improves the actual outcome. Request concise decisions and verifiable evidence where possible, and avoid treating generated reasoning as proof that the underlying claim is correct.
